name: avegancafe-marketplace
description: My personal Claude Code plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: kitchen-brigade
plugins.description: Lean, stack-agnostic multi-agent orchestration modeled on the brigade de cuisine. /chef routes to strategize / implement / workflow / diagnose; the chef runs the cast (sous-chef, cook, expediter). Bundles the yes-chef greenlight and dinner-rush concurrency skills.

plugins.name: avegancafe
plugins.description: My portable grab-bag of personal Claude Code tooling — a catch-all for the skills and hooks I carry across machines. Currently: beads (bd) capture/triage logging, tight bead titles, and a parent-epic-status PostToolUse hook.

plugins.name: projects
plugins.description: Manage a _projects/ folder: date-prefixed project directories (YYYY-MM-DD--<name>), each with a todo.md (checkbox todos, @-mentioned priorities, [assignee:<id>] assignees) and a <256-line README.md for small notes. Skills to initialize the folder (README + CLAUDE.md symlink), scaffold projects, and maintain todos.

plugins.name: session-ids
plugins.description: Gives every session a readable id (random adjective-noun pair, e.g. brave-otter) via a SessionStart hook, plus a skill library to retrieve the current session's id and info. Ids double as assignee ids for the projects plugin's todo.md files.
